answer.note: Columns 28-39 are named read_count_<sample> and hold per-gene counts (mostly whole numbers, some with decimals such as 668.68, so probably estimated/expected counts) next to separate FPKM and TPM columns. Only the replicate-1 samples are listed, since their column names (…1A) match the library names; replicates 2 and 3 are left out because the columns are labelled 3A and 4A, which cannot be matched to rep2 and rep3 from the names.
